name: Machine Chest Press
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Hold the weight up, then lower it slowly.
start_cue.hi: Weight upar pakdo, phir dheere neeche lao.

good.en: Good. You went down low enough.

fix.en: Take the weight down to your chest.

above.en: Go lower. Take the weight down to your chest.
above.hi: Neeche jao. Weight chest tak lao.

below.en: That is very deep. Stop when your upper arm is level.
below.hi: Yeh bahut neeche hai. Upper arm level aate hi ruko.

almost.en: Take the weight down to your chest.

fix.en: Push all the way up and straighten your arms.
fix.hi: Poora upar dhakelo aur haath seedhe karo.

almost.en: Push all the way up and straighten your arms.
almost.hi: Poora upar dhakelo aur haath seedhe karo.

good.en: Good. Your hands stayed over your elbows.
good.hi: Badhiya. Haath kohni ke upar rahe.

fix.en: Your hands drift. Keep wrists stacked over elbows.
fix.hi: Haath hat rahe hain. Kohni ke seedha upar rakho.

almost.en: Your hands drift. Keep wrists stacked over elbows.
almost.hi: Haath hat rahe hain. Kohni ke seedha upar rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weight. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weight. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.

fix.en: One arm is much lower. Move both arms together.
fix.hi: Ek haath bahut neeche hai. Dono haath saath chalao.

almost.en: One side is a little behind. Move them together.
almost.hi: Ek side thoda peeche hai. Dono saath chalao.
